📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • von Next Generation am 24.10.2026 in den Kategorien Champions League,Uncategorized mit 0 Kommentaren.
  • In a recent development, como beat Manchester United 4-1 — and in this case the scoreline really is a fair expression of the game.
  • Industry observers note that cesc Fàbregas’s side highlighted two things that rarely go together.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

von Next Generation am 24.10.2026 in den Kategorien Champions League,Uncategorized mit 0 Kommentaren.

In a recent development, como beat Manchester United 4-1 — and in this case the scoreline really is a fair expression of the game. For long stretches the match was one-sided, not in terms of chance volume but in terms of access: Como dictated in every phase where the ball went, who received it, and under what conditions it had to be played on. United never got on terms in any of those phases.

Industry observers note that cesc Fàbregas’s side highlighted two things that rarely go together. Out of possession, a pressing structure with clear direction, isolation of one side, and man-marking that applied near the ball only for the action in progress while everything around it was already speculating on the second ball. And in possession, a positional game of remarkable technical maturity that ties opponents in, switches play, and works systematically into the space behind them. The 4-1 is therefore less an outlier than evidence of work that has been built up over recent seasons.

This analysis goes through the phases one by one: first Como in possession and United’s response, then the work against the ball from the high press to defending the box, and finally the goals.

It has been revealed that in build-up, Como moved away from their nominal 4-2-3-1 and sat closer to a 4-3-3, with the eights as the real variable: very free in their movement and above all active in the half-spaces. The base structure stayed stable — a flat four plus a six in front of them, sometimes ahead of the line, sometimes slightly behind the forward line.

Close to their own goal, Como consistently involved goalkeeper Butez as an additional central player in the build-up. That created a five-against-four against United’s front line — awkward on paper, more awkward still in execution, because Como didn’t use the overload to play through but to tie opponents in. From there, the same shape kept appearing on both the right and the left: centre-back, full-back, a player from the half-position in the eight space, and a six alongside. A diamond that wasn’t an end in itself but had a purpose: the diagonal route out.

Como’s build-up structure. From a 4-1 (flat four), the half-positions with Paz and Perrone are added. Small triangles and diamonds emerge. The three attackers ahead of them create additional options in behind.

One detail deserves particular attention. At times the full-backs stood not wide but flat, in a half-position. That sounds like a nuance, but it had a clear function: it vacated the wing and created the space the eights could drop into — Paz and Perrone did so regularly. If you don’t occupy the wing yourself, you force the opponent to guard it anyway.

ManU got no access near the ball and left large diagonal spaces open on the far side.

For United’s midfielders this was close to unsolvable. Tielemans, Mount and Andrey Santos spent the whole game struggling to establish any responsibility at all, let alone get into duels. When an eight dropped out, they couldn’t follow, and if one of them was tied in by it, a two-against-one opened up on the far wing. Como didn’t create that situation once; they created it serially.

The decisive mechanism lay in receiving and relaying the ball. The player in the deeper position usually worked with two touches: the first took the ball backwards, the second relayed it to the free teammate. At the end of every one of those actions stood a player with the game in front of him — and from that open position he could switch play.

What made it possible were the preparatory movements. Paz and captain Da Cunha first lured their markers in the wrong direction and then worked with the head start they’d bought. That head start isn’t only space, it’s above all time: time to control the ball first and relay it second, rather than having to do both in one touch.

In a recent development, A scene in the 17th minute is typical. Mason Mount steps out, Mazraoui goes into the duel at the same time — nominally United are in an overload here. Only neither of them really gets to the opponent, because both are too late. Paz can therefore calmly take his touch backwards and switch play directly with the second, dissolving the pressure before it had even formed.

Industry observers note that when the build-up ran down the right, it demonstrated in a recurring pattern: Paz and Da Cunha took the first touch backwards or inside and then switched with the left foot out of a closed body position. The players they found were systematically in open positions — Milla, the far-side six, or the wing-to-wing connection directly.

In the second half, Como adjusted the shape and more often played with two sixes, to form the diamonds faster and switch to the far-side six faster. Couto stood out in this: the right-back repeatedly played the chip into the six or ten space — six or seven times in a row during one spell. It was mainly Paz who received the ball there and could launch the attack.

In the second half Como focus on those diagonal spaces and look for them mainly with chipped balls.

Sources indicate that especially striking inside the diamond are the rotations between the players. Because of the connections between them, they moved in rotation depending on running path, space and ball movement. The same recurring spaces were re-occupied. Under pressure on the ball carrier, the outer players pushed flat or ran in behind the opponents; the highest player in the diamond burst out of the cover shadow and became the reference point in depth. On a deep pass, the two wide players released and joined the depth, able to offer themselves again immediately in an open body position. If the pass went via the flat wide players, the spaces in front of the new ball carrier could be run into. Every rotation, every positional adjustment was coordinated with the others and, in the end, produced a stream of pressure-resolving passes while Manchester United chased the press in vain.

Recent findings suggest that como bridged the middle third exceptionally quickly, via dribbles at speed and diagonal passes. Behind it stood a recognisable principle: first tie the opponent to one wing, then get behind them via the diagonal, and in the final third do the same thing again. In sum, that produced the shape of a Z — build-up on the right, transition on the left, finish from the right again.

In this example Como pin ManU in the press with their short passing. Thanks to the extra attacker on the ball-near side they can play through the pressure and switch.

Industry observers note that the connections between wingers and striker carried these attacks and were deliberately kept flexible. The wide players sometimes stayed wide, sometimes came short, sometimes tucked inside. Douvikas accordingly either waited deep in front of the line for the chipped ball or, when space opened up on the wing, received the deeper pass and then ran in behind along the wing as soon as the ball sat on the full-back’s open foot. That flexibility produced the overloads on one side, and the overloads produced the central overload.

In a recent development, in the final third one element was added that is rare in fast transition teams: patience. Como drew opponents towards them with dribbles and short passes, used back-passes when needed, and then switched in front of the block. Da Cunha, Baturina and Paz were the three who could tie opponents in and then find the diagonal. They created the positions on the diagonal, were available to receive, and used their space to apply pressure. The block was usually tied in with short touches, the switch and the position behind the opponent prepared, and quick finishes sought.

According to recent reports, the intensity in possession shouldn’t be underestimated. Practically every attack involved at least three or four players, the width was occupied, the centre likewise, and there were multiple options throughout. What they looked for almost every time was the space behind the opponent on the far side — exactly the zone that is closed last when a block shifts across.

In a recent development, paz brought the right profile for this pattern. A strong left foot cutting inside from the right, he repeatedly dropped into the right-hand blind side of his opponents, got shots away there with few touches, and racked up the most shots of the match. That the finishes generally came off few touches isn’t a detail but the consequence of the time won further back.

As the move continues, Como again look for the blind side of the defenders. Here Douvikas and Paz are positioned in behind, with Da Cunha joining in front of the back line. After briefly pinning the opponents, the switch reaches Da Cunha, who misses the target from distance.

Recent findings suggest that what carries all of this is the technical execution. Soft passes, sharp ones when the moment called for it, consistently well timed and played into the right foot — for ninety minutes. Passing that secure at that tempo is what makes a variable concept actually retrievable.

According to recent reports, united’s basic problem out of possession was the hybrid. They pressed half man-oriented, but with a plus-one in the last line — a construction that forces compromises in both directions. It demands access up front that it doesn’t fund at the back.

There were certainly moments when it worked. When Dalot pushed through into the press on the right and passed his man backwards, a clean man-orientation emerged all the way up to the front — and with it a clear assignment for Mount, out of which the ball could be won. But that stayed the exception. Most of the time Dalot sat too flat out of possession, so United couldn’t trigger the duels up front and went into the press a man short.

Sources indicate that mount was the most conspicuous case in this respect. He barely got into a duel across the whole match because the decision to step out always came too late. Against a team that works with preparatory movements, a late decision is practically the same as none: the opponent already has the head start before the journey even begins.

On top of that came a problem on the far side. There, United’s winger frequently failed to protect the depth — usually Mbeumo, who jogged back rather than closing the space. But that was precisely the target zone of Como’s diagonal switches. It allowed them to change sides almost at will and regularly find an open structure on the other side.

The second half brought no improvement. The distances to opponents stayed large, and centrally what was actually intended still didn’t materialise. Michael Carrick’s double change at half-time was meant to bring more physicality to the six with Carlos Baleba, but it didn’t solve the problem — the assignments still didn’t work, the duels in the centre still didn’t happen, and the wide positions dragged the eights out further, which opened upcoming spaces.

It has been revealed that in the end the energy simply wasn’t there to press with the necessary intensity. United’s press became increasingly static, and a static press against an opponent with this passing quality yields not a single ball win — it only hands them the starting positions they’re looking for anyway.

In a recent development, como started the game in a high press and sustained it above all in the first half, with isolated spells after the break too. It was triggered on back-passes and goal kicks — and, remarkably, by their own goals: after every strike the team immediately pushed high again instead of managing the lead in a deeper block.

It has been revealed that the steering ran consistently towards United’s left build-up side. The reason is personnel: Harry Maguire played there with his weaker left foot as the outside foot, and next to him stood another right-footer in Noussair Mazraoui on the left. Two right-footers on one build-up side means the ball always has to be taken back inside to play on — exactly where Como were closing the door. The press was usually triggered by the left-sided forward, with the ball ending up at either Maguire or Mazraoui.

Pressing structure after the change in the second half.

According to recent reports, in the centre Como defended man-oriented, with both sixes pushing very high and taking flat passes into United’s midfielders out of the game. That removed the short route through the middle as an option and left the long ball. But the long ball triggered nothing for United: the second balls went to Como practically every time.

It has been revealed that that isn’t chance, it’s running work. The sixes consistently tracked the negative pressing paths back, anticipated the long ball early, and were in front of the line before it arrived. Luis Milla covered the most ground of any player on the pitch in this pattern — recovery runs after being played past, doubling up on the ball, attacking the second ball. When the long ball came from Maguire or one of the full-backs, a six was regularly in front of the line with an intense sprint, sealing the centre, taking away the diagonal follow-up passes and attacking the loose balls.

Defending the long ball and extra support on the second ball.

Once the ball was on one side, that side was isolated. The near-side forward had access to the centre-back and dropped back a touch when the pass went to the full-back, so that he covered centre-back and six simultaneously and closed the square pass. The far-side forward marked the goalkeeper. That served two functions at once: it took away United’s escape route via the keeper along with the switch, and it kept a player in position for the moment of the turnover.

The double pivot worked in a deliberate half-position. The near-side six stayed tight to his man, the far-side one dropped slightly behind him — securing the space and at the same time establishing access to the far-side centre-back in United’s back three.

According to recent reports, the last line defended largely man-for-man in the high press, and very tightly. But the decisive detail is the one that carries the whole concept: the man-marking near the ball applied only to the action in progress. Around it, players were already releasing from their assignments and orienting towards the second ball. That is only retrievable at very high intensity — and it’s the reason United’s forced long balls produced not a single usable moment.

In a recent development, when Como dropped a line, the man-orientation at the second height stayed exceptionally high. Here too the back-pass served as the trigger to push up as a unit and tip back into man-marking. If United were in a closed body position, the Comaschi had already pushed up far enough to attack the back-pass at the moment it was played — a pattern that led directly to the 3-0. The half-position was at work there again: closing down level with the centre-back while simultaneously prepared to push through onto the next player deeper.

In a recent development, in the first half Como still had problems assigning the half-positions against ManU’s 3-2-5. In this example Fernandes moves to the wing, Como fail to establish responsibility and access and are played through at mid-height.

Up to half-time, though, Como had a structural problem with this. The pure man-marking didn’t come off cleanly, because of the two sixes in front of the line, one should really have tucked in and taken over the half-position for the centre-backs. That didn’t happen consistently. The consequence: a centre-back stepped out, the space behind him stayed unoccupied, and that was exactly what United kept attacking.

Industry observers note that the pattern of pressing onto Manchester United’s left side continued in the second half, now with Dalot at full-back. The press was still triggered by Douvikas, with the ball-near winger pushing up as a second striker to press the centre-back. Paz focused on the visitors’ ball-near six and Couto pushed through onto Dalot. Through the central connections the game was isolated on one side.

At half-time Como adjusted. One six moved directly into the line, with the far-side winger pushing in onto the six — they now pressed out of a 5-2-1-2. Lucas Da Cunha pressed through from the right onto Maguire, while Nico Paz picked up United’s six. The central forward pressed the central centre-back and from there carried on to the goalkeeper. The far-side wide midfielder and the remaining six were poised — one onto United’s free six, one onto the far-side centre-back — again in that half-position between opponent and the space to be protected.

ManU building up high against the man-oriented Italians.

It has been revealed that the effect was immediately visible. Como controlled the half-positions, got access right into the last line throughout, and set the rhythm of the match from then on. The adjustment solved exactly the problem the first half had left open, without changing the underlying principle.

In the final phase Como defended from a very deep line inside the box. That left barely any space behind the line to play into — which United hardly looked for anyway. The visitors attacked little depth and rarely occupied the width in the final third, so Como could stay compact without being punished for it.

Accordingly, a lot of players stood very centrally in and in front of the box. That produced numerous cover shadows and a numerical superiority around the ball, which allowed them to steer actively within the block rather than merely react. At times they deliberately steered inside, to guide the opponent into the prepared congestion and cover from a deeper position.

Sources indicate that deep back line in the box, centre closed and play steered inside. The box defending allowed the English side shots from distance.

The crucial point is that Como left the gaps open not despite this set-up but because of it. If you pack the box and secure the depth, you give up the space in front of the line — and that is exactly where United were supposed to shoot from.

The numbers vindicate the decision. Taking the conceded goal out of the box, Como allowed nine shots from outside the penalty area across ninety minutes, worth roughly 0.24 xG combined; only three of them were even on target. On top of that, of the four shots inside the box, two came from at least 14 to 15 metres and effectively belong in the long-range category as well. United accepted the invitation, and the shooting quality was perfectly decent — it’s just that with that scoring probability over a whole match, the most likely outcome is precisely what happened.

Tracking the ball for the first goal.

1-0, Nico Paz (2′) — The goal comes before United are even set. Como take the goal kick rapidly and play straight to the full-back, luring the visitors into the press — only not cleanly. Mason Mount triggers the pressure and is played past, and on the second ball he goes into the duel as well instead of holding the middle and looking for the space where he could pick the ball up. That is exactly what opens the centre, the space for the second ball is there, and Paz can play it through.

Recent findings suggest that what follows is the transition principle in its purest form: a quick switch to the diagonal side, then short passes against a very deep line. Matheus Cunha doesn’t pick up the player behind him and leaves the ten space open, where Paz is standing. He needs two touches because neither Cunha from above nor Maguire from his distance gets into the duel. Lammens, for his part, doesn’t defend the goal with his cover shadow but takes the near post — which leaves the far corner to a strong left foot. The curled finish into it is quality, though.

2-0, Anastasios Douvikas (49′, assist Paz) — Same zone, same cause. Bryan Mbeumo doesn’t choose to shut the centre but closes the centre-back, which creates the space for Da Cunha, who drives forward and plays Martin Baturina in. Centrally, Mount again fails to pick up his man. Out wide, Amad Diallo, introduced at half-time, generates no pressure centrally, so Mazraoui can’t take over the deep wide player in the first place.

According to recent reports, the result is Paz behind the opponent, in the ten space, dribbling unopposed at goal. Matthijs de Ligt establishes no reference to Douvikas’s run in behind and slips as well — a one-against-one with the goalkeeper that Douvikas finishes coolly.

3-0, Nico Paz (57′) — The only goal that comes directly out of the work against the ball. Como are in the midfield press in a closed position with access to the inside lane, win the ball there and punish a lapse of concentration in the visitors’ build-up. At the end, Paz is alone in front of Lammens again.

Industry observers note that 4-0, Jacobo Ramón (76′, assist Kaiki) — This goal comes from a longer possession spell and reveals the assignment problem in its clearest form. Mazraoui is too narrow and has no access to the wide player. Diallo stands in the space with access to neither the central player nor the full-back nor the winger — an orientation that doesn’t work in any direction.

Como switch to Máximo Perrone, who can slide the ball out wide because the space is simply free. From there comes the cross from an open body position, and in the centre Como run a two-against-one at the end of which Ramón scores.

According to recent reports, 4-1, Joshua Zirkzee (90′) — Como’s only lapse, and one in a phase in which the team had already dropped very deep. United get the ball to the wing, it’s two against two in the box, and the cross is initially only feinted. Zirkzee orients himself well forwards at that moment, while Como’s defenders are already stepping out after the feinted cross. Diallo’s ball in behind the line is strong, the offside call is razor-thin in his favour, and Zirkzee takes two touches before finishing one-against-one with the goalkeeper. A blemish, not a structural problem.

Recent findings suggest that the common denominator — Three of Como’s four goals come in the same zone: the space in front of and behind United’s line that nobody takes responsibility for. Mount is involved in two of those scenes through an assignment he never establishes, Diallo in two more after coming on. Nico Paz is at the heart of three of the four goals, twice as scorer, once as the provider — always out of the opponent’s blind side.

According to recent reports, como’s 4-1 has one common cause across every phase, and it lies less in any single idea than in its execution under continuous load. Out of possession they steered, isolated and speculated on the second ball — with man-marking that applied near the ball only for the action in progress and was already dissolved around it. In possession they tied opponents in, switched play and worked systematically into the space behind. Both require eleven players to anticipate a teammate’s decision, and both functioned over the full distance.

Recent findings suggest that the connecting detail is the half-position. In the press, the far-side six stood between opponent and the space to be protected; in possession, the eights worked out of the same zone, and the full-backs occupied it flat in order to vacate the wing for exactly those players. Como, in other words, occupied the position in both directions from which two jobs can be done at once — which is why the side could neither be played past in the press nor be pinned in the build-up.

For United the diagnosis is more uncomfortable than the result. The problem wasn’t individual errors but that the team never, in any phase, got into the duels it needed. The mixture of half man-orientation and a plus-one in the last line funded no access up front, and without access every decision is made too late — from Mount in the centre to Mbeumo failing to secure the far-side depth. Carrick’s double change at half-time was meant to bring physicality to the six with Carlos Baleba, but it changed nothing about the assignments, and in Diallo a player came on wide who reached neither one opponent nor the other in his space. That the energy ran out in the end was a consequence rather than a cause.

Industry observers note that that leaves the context. A 4-1 against Manchester United is no proof in itself, and Como’s finishing was exceptionally efficient on the night. What revealed regardless of the result, though, is a team with a recognisable, rehearsed answer in all four phases of the game — and one that put a technical maturity on the pitch in possession that you wouldn’t readily credit to a side promoted two years ago.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Nell'intervista pre-partita, il tecnico del Lecce Di Francesco ha commentato la sfida contro la Lazio, soffermandosi sulla crescita del gruppo e sulla maggiore consapevolezza biancoceleste.

Sabato all'Olimpico arriva il Lecce per sfidare la Lazio, attualmente prima in classifica: alla vigilia del match, il tecnico giallorosso Eusebio Di Francesco ha sottolineato nella conferenza stampa l'entusiasmo dei biancocelesti, le loro qualità tecniche ed esaltato Gattuso, evidenziando la forza e la crescita del gruppo..

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

According to recent reports, L'ultimo a essere rientrato è Gaspar, è tornato ieri sera e si è allenato con la squadra. Non ci sono stati problemi dovuti al rientro. Ho un paio di dubbi, dietro e in mezzo al campo. Davanti già so quali saranno gli interpreti di questa gara.

Industry observers note that ho sempre parlato di coraggio, voglio un atteggiamento propositivo, ho visto una squadra allenarsi davvero bene in queste due settimane. Sono fiducioso di quello che il gruppo mi può dare. La Lazio ha grande entusiasmo, sta facendo molto bene, ha mantenuto giocatori di qualità e ha acquisito maggiore consapevolezza nei propri mezzi. Gattuso sta facendo veramente bene. Dobbiamo giocarcela, scendendo in campo senza timore reverenziale.

It has been revealed that tutto si lega al risultato, io mi voglio affidare alle caratteristiche dei calciatori più che ai sistemi di gioco. Se ho fatto certe scelte contro il Torino deriva dal fatto che non avevo esterni, oggi ho recuperato Monteiro. A Torino volevo dare consapevolezza e forza a una squadra che aveva preso tanti gol, stavamo soffrendo sulle palle alte e sul finale ho messo un difensore in più. Giocando a cinque dietro non abbiamo subito un tiro per 70 minuti. Volevamo prima di tutto fare una grande fase difensiva e ritrovare solidità e ci siamo riusciti. Per me abbiamo fatto una gara davvero importante.

It has been revealed that pierotti è un'assenza importante per le sue caratteristiche. Alle mie ali ho chiesto di lavorare nello stesso modo sia quando attaccano sia quando difendono. Lo fanno le grandi squadre, figuriamoci noi. Berisha sta sicuramente meglio, ha alternato allenamenti con la squadra a giorni di recupero per evitare ricadute, ma è un giocatore che deve acquisire la forma migliore, però mi è piaciuto. Dobbiamo avere la giusta cautela. Monteiro si è allenato con la squadra, è recuperato e può anche partire dall'inizio.

Recent findings suggest that abbiamo lavorato su come legare i tre di centrocampo coi quattro di difesa. Ma non dimentichiamoci anche della fase offensiva, i nostri attaccanti si devono ancora sbloccare, dobbiamo avere fiducia in loro.

Dobbiamo essere più squadra, quando si difende e si attacca. Abbiamo cambiato sistema di gioco poche volte, per necessità o per scelta. Questa squadra è stata costruita per giocare con il 4-3-3 o 4-2-3-1. Da qui a fine gennaio ci saranno tante partite, l'augurio è quello di poter scegliere i migliori giocatori di partita in partita.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

La conferenza stampa di Gennaro Gattuso in occasione della sfida casalinga contro il Lecce.

Sources indicate that la sosta per gli impegni delle nazionali è finalmente giunta al termine, e le squadre di Serie A sono pronte a scendere in campo per la dodicesima giornata. In occasione del prossimo turno, la Lazio ospiterà allo stadio Olimpico di Roma il Lecce di Di Francese per la sfida in programma sabato 21 novembre alle ore 15:00. Dalla sala stampa del Training Center di Formello, il mister Gattuso è intervenuto in conferenza stampa per presentare il match contro i salentini.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Industry observers note that su Frattesi non devo riflettere, ha fatto tutto col gruppo, sta bene e a livello strumentale non ha nulla. Se oggi arriva e ha il raffreddore vediamo, ma ha fatto tutto. Isaksen e Provstgaard hanno fatto un lavoro in palestra come Dele-Bashiru e Belahyane. Tutti i giocatori hanno lavorato con noi. Zaccagni sta lavorando sul campo, c’è ancora un po’ di edema, ma riesce a gestire. Nuno ha cominciato riabilitazione in piscina con Sutalo. Marusic ha avuto una piccola ricaduta, sulla ricaduta che ha avuto un mese fa. Settimana prossima valutiamo in che condizione sono. Gli altri sono tutti a disposizione. Cataldi ieri non si è allenato, ha avuto un piccolo problema all’adduttore, ma pensiamo non sia nulla di grave.

Si pensa a domani, non a quello che dobbiamo fare dopo. Giochiamo contro una squadra solida e allenata bene, ha dieci punti in classifica. Ha vinto con l’Udinese e col Venezia, una squadra molto insidiosa sui calci piazzati. Dobbiamo prenderli con le pinze. Sta a noi come sempre. Servirà mentalità e voglia di stare in campo e giocare a ritmi elevati. È una partita molto difficile.

In a recent development, ci può stare, ma per come giochiamo il modulo non c’entra niente. Dipende solo come andare a prendere gli avversari in pressing. L’importante è andare a occupare le posizioni libere, cambia poco. Conta la voglia, la partecipazione e la mentalità. Per questo, si può fare tutto, se andate a vedere quando facciamo pressioni stiamo solo con un vertice. Conta poco il modulo.

Non devo entrare solo nella sua, devo entrare nella testa di tutti. Lui è un giocatore importante ma ci sono anche gli altri. Bisogna capire cosa significa giocare poco. Sia Dele-Bashiru e Lazzari ci danno sempre un contributo quando entrano. Albert quando sta bene è un giocatore di altissimo livello. Domani tanti di loro che hanno trovato poco spazio avranno la possibilità di giocare dal primo minuto, ma sono tranquillo. L’importante è avere la consapevolezza che i giocatori hanno una buona condizione.

Sources indicate that per come sono fatto io non sono mai sereno, fa parte del mio modo di essere. Ho la consapevolezza che sono ragazzi che non si risparmiano mai. La qualità di corsa è alta, sono tutti ad un ottimo livello e questo mi riempie d’orgoglio. Domani dovremo far parlare in campo e metterlo in pratica.

Quando ho detto che non abbiamo niente da perdere mi hanno guardato storto, ma altri ragionamenti si fanno nelle ultime partite. Noi dobbiamo vivere partita dopo partita. Giochiamocela domani, poi vedremo dove si arriva. Io alleno una squadra che in questo momento deve vivere alla giornata. Le partite bisogna giocarle, importante è che non sbagliamo a livello di atteggiamento.

Recent findings suggest that ieri abbiamo visto la partita contro il Napoli, serve la mentalità, il guardarsi. Il veleno su ogni palla, quello deve essere nel nostro DNA. Siamo andati là e potevamo fare più di un gol, poi nel primo quarto d’ora potevamo perderla, poi siamo tornati in partita. Non bisogna dimenticare cosa ci ha portato qui. Se siamo qui è perchè giochiamo da squadra, perché non si molla di un centimetro. Poi si può sempre sbagliare, lo accettiamo sempre, l’importante è che non manchi la voglia di soffrire in campo. La squadra ha avuto miglioramenti, a volte siamo usciti dal campo e Mandas ci ha dato una mano, ma a livello di personalità abbiamo fatto un step importante. Bisogna lavorare sempre con personalità, senza dimenticare da dove siamo partiti.

In a recent development, non mi piace fare il gitano, amo andare in giro e toccare con mano le mentalità di altri paesi. La mia crescita viene anche da tutti i giri che ho fatto. Noi italiani pensiamo sempre di essere i più forti, ma su tantissime cose nel calcio riesci a mettere dentro anche delle altre culture. Non penso se dovrò rimanere o meno, penso a quello che dovrò fare oggi. Sembra che io sia qui da dieci anni, mi sento a mio agio qui. Spero di rimanerci a lungo, difficilmente puoi trovare posti così.

Ho grande fiducia, vedo quello che fanno e come lavorano. Doekhi si è trovato fuori, ma quando ha giocato ha sempre fatto bene. C’è grande fiducia sul reparto difensivo. Pedraza non ha mai giocato, ma ha messo minutaggio da subentrato. C’è fiducia nei loro confronti. Romano? Ci sta che certe volte possa soffrire in fase difensiva, ma l’esperienza si fa giocando, con questo tipo di partite che sta giocando. Ci sta che possa subire questo tipo di partite. Siamo contenti che abbia rinnovato, ha grande voglia e senso di appartenenza.

Lui in questo momento per la mentalità che ha, può giocare anche a centrocampo e in difesa. Ha una convinzione e una condizione fisica incredibile. Lui può fare l’ala e l’ha dimostrato a Napoli, giocando con voglia e mentalità, ma può giocare ovunque. Non sono d’accordo con voi, avete massacrato Pinamonti dopo Napoli, si è speso tanto nel primo tempo. Nella ripresa abbiamo sofferto tutti, lui è in grandissima crescita.

Saranno affari loro se giocano alla playstation, non so nemmeno di che stai parlando. Non mi creo questo problema. Questo fa parte dell’essere professionista, di avere amor proprio del proprio lavoro. Non mi permetterei mai di chiedere ad un giocatore se ha dormito o meno. Vediamo domani mattina, ci sarà la colazione tutti insieme e mi metterò là concentrato e vedremo se qualcuno avrà fatto le ore piccole o meno.

Con lui abbiamo parlato, sapevo dove andare a parare. Si toccava con mano che tutto quello che era stato fatto non gli era entrato bene nella testa, ma ci sta: veniva da un calcio totalmente diverso. Tutte le nostre proposte erano arabo per lui, lo sapevo già. Da lì ha svoltato, gli ho detto che doveva chiedere ciò che non capiva e siamo rimasti di più in campo. Dopo gli è venuto più facile. Ci ha fatto vincere qualche partita, ma ci stava che all’inizio, avendo fatto cose totalmente diverse, avesse difficoltà. Sono sicuro che domani farà una grande partita.

Non è facile, anche un mese fa siamo stati fermi venti giorni. Non passano mai. Sappiamo quello che abbiamo dovuto fare, non è facile. Ci sono anche Champions, Europa e Conference. È una cosa di UEFA e FIFA che devono sedersi per mettersi d’accordo coi club, altrimenti non se ne esce fuori. Quando giocavo, a fine anno controllavo e avevo fatto 52 partite. Il problema è che adesso si gioca anche il venerdì e il sabato alle 15. I tempi di recupero sono diversi. Non siamo le persone adatte per lamentarci per quello che guadagnamo. I salari dei giocatori sono importanti, non vengo qua a lamentarmi.

According to recent reports, quella di domani. C’è poco da rispondere. I tre punti di domani sono uguali ai prossimi, non abbiamo priorità. L’avversario è diverso, ma per me è troppo difficile dirti cosa penso. Io penso alla gara di domani, poi vedremo cosa succederà a Torino. Come se adesso mi chiedessi del derby, so che tutti ci aspettano perché vogliono che vinciamo il derby, ma pensa come ci arrivo se ci comincio a pensare ora.

Feyenoord preserved their four-point advantage over champions PSV after coming away with a point from Eindhoven thanks to an improved second-half performance.

PSV dominated the first half as they deployed a close-passing, tiki-taka style to stifle Feyenoord, but only had Guus Til’s well-taken volley after 20 minutes to show for it.

Ten minutes after the break Feyenoord equalised when Anis Hadj Moussa was given too much space to charge down the right flank and bend a shot inside the far post.

The Algerian had a good chance for a second towards the end, while PSV goalkeeper Matej Kovar had to be alert to keep out a header by Nacho Ferri from close range.

According to recent reports, “We were by far the better team today and had the better chances,” noted PSV coach Peter Bosz. “We started the second half badly and made a mistake, after which Hadj Moussa scored. And even then we could have won it.”.

In a recent development, ajax overtook PSV to close the gap at the top to three points with a hard-fought win at Sparta. Veteran striker Jens Toornstra scored for Sparta on his 500th Eredivisie appearance, but Abdellah Ouazane and Tolu Arokodare, the scorers against Atalanta in midweek, were on target again to claim the win for Ajax.

Twente moved up to fourth place as two late goals by Sondre Ørjasæter and Lucas Vennegoor of Hesselink earned a 2-0 win at AZ Alkmaar, who like Twente and PSV have 20 points.

Fortuna Sittard also snatched the points late on against Excelsior as Rodrigo Guth headed in a corner in injury time to keep the Limburg club in sixth place, two points further back.

At the other end of the table, the return of Adrie Koster as veteran coach brought no relief to Willem II, who crashed to a 6-1 home defeat to Cambuur.

The Tilburgers remain four points behind ADO Den Haag, who were unable to keep up the momentum of last week’s win against PSV as they lost 3-2 at home to Heerenveen.

Telstar lost by the same margin at Go Ahead Eagles, whose striker Søren Tengstedt netted twice in the first half to lead the Eredivisie scoring charts with eight goals.

Willem II Tilburg 1-6 Cambuur Leeuwarden.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Au cours d'un match plaisant, les Verts se sont imposés en Champagne 1 but à 0 grâce au meilleur joueur de L2 la saison passée, Zuriko Davitashvili.

In a recent development, le Géorgien n'était pas titulaire au coup d'envoi. Ian Cathro privilégiant la continuité en attaque avec le quatuor Ballo - Breum - Boakye - Cardona. Derrière, Pedro et Le Cardinal occupaient la charnière et Ferreira / Old, les côtés.

According to recent reports, si les Verts étaient rapidement sauvé par Csongvai qui contrait in extremis un tir remois dans la surface, ils allaient toutefois se procurer de belles occasions. Sur un centre de Cardona, Ballo ratait sa tête en cherchant à remiser pour Breum face au but. Plus tard, ce fut Boakye qui décochait une belle frappe captée par le gardien. Enfin, sur un centre venu de la droite, Cardona reprenait en retrait en première intention mais sa frappe rasait le montant.

In a recent development, au retour des vestiaires, Reims se faisait plus pressant. Les Champenois allaient même se créer une belle occasion. Tia enrhumait Pedro mais sa frappe trouvait un Ndiaye impeccable, Fofana ne pouvait pas cadrer sur le second ballon.

It has been revealed that ce fut au tour des Verts de reprendre la main avec un mouvement collectif sublime. Csongvai trouvait Breum qui s'appuyait sur Cardona qui alertait Boakye à gauche. Le centre ras terre devant le but trouvait Davitashvili qui n'avait plus qu'à pousser au fond des buts (0-1, 61e).

Les Verts cadenassaient la défense et procédaient en contre sans parvenir à doubler la mise malgré de belles situations.

Cette 2e défaite de la saison pour les Remois permet à l'ASSE de reprendre 3 points d'avance sur Nancy en tête de la L2 et de porter son avance à 10 points sur son adversaire du soir, et 7 sur le 3e, Montpellier, battu à Laval.

Tech Report: Lazio-Lecce, Fascetti: biancocelesti favoriti, ma serve attenzione

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Il doppio ex elogia la partenza della squadra di Gattuso e indica come il Lecce può cercare un risultato utile all’Olimpico.
  • Per Eugenio Fascetti, la Lazio è nettamente favorita contro il Lecce nella sfida di domani alle 15 all’Olimpico.
  • CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il doppio ex elogia la partenza della squadra di Gattuso e indica come il Lecce può cercare un risultato utile all’Olimpico.

Per Eugenio Fascetti, la Lazio è nettamente favorita contro il Lecce nella sfida di domani alle 15 all’Olimpico. Secondo quanto riportato da La Gazzetta del Mezzogiorno, Il doppio ex, però, avverte che i giallorossi dovranno giocare tutte le proprie carte per cercare un risultato utile. Elogia inoltre l’avvio dei biancocelesti, pur indicando nell’Inter la sua favorita per lo scudetto.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Fascetti ha allenato il Lecce dalla stagione 1983/1984 alla 1985/1986. Con il presidente Franco Jurlano, il direttore sportivo Mimmo Cataldo e i calciatori della stagione 1984/1985 conquistò la prima promozione del club salentino in Serie A. Da giocatore aveva vestito anche la maglia della Lazio nel 1964/1965; dopo l’esperienza a Lecce, guidò i biancocelesti nel 1986/1987 e nel 1987/1988.

According to recent reports, A Roma ottenne prima la salvezza tra i cadetti, nonostante una penalizzazione iniziale di nove punti, poi la promozione in A. A 88 anni, dopo una vita trascorsa nel calcio tra campo e panchina, l’allenatore viareggino continua a seguire con attenzione la massima serie italiana e non solo.

Fascetti conserva un legame con entrambe le piazze: «Ho splendidi ricordi delle esperienze vissute in entrambe le piazze». Ripensando alla promozione leccese, aggiunge: «Due avventure che rammento con molto piacere. A Lecce, con un grande gruppo di lavoro, dalla dirigenza allo staff, dai calciatori ad ogni collaboratore, raggiungemmo un traguardo che tutti, nel Salento, sognavano. Fu una cavalcata straordinaria, come del resto i festeggiamenti di popolo che seguirono, coinvolgendo un intero territorio.».

According to recent reports, A quel traguardo Fascetti affianca il ricordo della morte di Michele Lorusso e Ciro Pezzella: «In giallorosso, purtroppo, ho vissuto anche un grave lutto, la tragica morte di Michele e di Ciro (le bandiere Lorusso e Pezzella ndr), che ancora oggi, a distanza di oltre 40 anni da quel maledetto 2 dicembre 1983, mi procura dolore solo a parlarne. Anche con la Lazio, però, ci siamo tolti delle belle soddisfazioni».

Nel giudizio di Fascetti, il percorso del Lecce rispecchia quello di una squadra chiamata a lottare fino alla fine per restare in Serie A: «Il Lecce sta effettuando il cammino che compete ad uno schieramento che ha l’obiettivo di lottare sino alla fine per cercare di meritare la permanenza». Sugli alti e bassi precisa: «Per le formazioni costruite per salvarsi, è scontato che vadano messi in conto degli alti e bassi. Non potrebbe essere diversamente. I giallorossi sono in linea con le aspettative e dovranno battagliare con i denti per provare a compiere l’ennesima impresa sportiva degli ultimi anni. La sofferenza fa parte del dna degli appassionati salentini».

Il presidente Saverio Sticchi Damiani e gli altri soci cercano di conciliare i risultati con un calcio sostenibile e conti in ordine. Finora, secondo Fascetti, ci sono riusciti. L’ex tecnico considera questa strada necessaria per i club di provincia: «Per le piccole realtà di provincia non ci sono alternative».

It has been revealed that il paragone di Fascetti va alla gestione che conobbe a Lecce: «Ai miei tempi, Jurlano e Cataldo si sono dimostrati bravissimi a regalare a più riprese la serie A al Lecce a costi limitati. Due autentici campioni. L’attuale proprietà si muove lungo la medesima direttrice ed è la scelta giusta, anche se i tifosi, in quanto tali, vorrebbero soffrire di meno».

Sports club members becoming less tolerant of homosexuality

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Acceptance of homosexuality in Dutch sports clubs has declined significantly in the last generation, according to a survey of attitudes by the Mulier Institute.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

Acceptance of homosexuality in Dutch sports clubs has declined significantly in the last generation, according to a survey of attitudes by the Mulier Institute.

The organisation found that 66% of people had no objection to a fellow member of a sports club being gay, while in 2008 the figure was 85%.

Just over half (55%) of respondents noted they had no problem sharing a shower with a gay team-mate of the same sex, which also represented a drop from 73% in 2008.

The Mulier Institute mentioned the findings reflected a social trend that has also been seen in schools, where the proportion of boys aged between 12 and 16 with a positive view of homosexuality has dropped from 40% to 22% since 2021.

The Dutch Olympic Committee NOC*NSF said the findings were “highly regrettable” and pledged to step up its efforts to make sport more inclusive.

But the John Blankenstein Foundation, which campaigns for LGBT emancipation in sport, said it had noticed declining enthusiasm for its workshops and growing numbers of parents who voiced objections.

Karin Blankenstein, who set up the organisation in 2008, told NOS: “I get the sensitivity around transgender people in sport at the top level, but this is about amateur sport.”.

L'Union rapporte les propos de l'entraîneur rémois Nicolas Usaï après la première défaite à domicile de la saison de son équipe, désormais à 10 longueurs de ses bourreaux d'hier, les solides leaders stéphanois.

Industry observers note that "Il y a de la déception par rapport à l’engagement que l’on a mis dans le match. On sait que ça se joue sur des détails, on a concédé peu d’occasions par rapport à la faculté de notre adversaire. On n’a pas été assez efficaces dans nos moments forts, particulièrement dans les 25 premières minutes. Après le but, on a manqué un peu d’allant, peut-être un peu d’énergie. On savait que c’était une opposition de qualité. Rien à reprocher aux joueurs dans le comportement, dans l’engagement.

Recent findings suggest that la maîtrise était stéphanoise. Dans le coeur du jeu, ils ont réussi à éteindre rapidement les quelques étincelles que l’on a pu avoir. On est déçus par rapport au résultat. Quand on joue dans un stade comme ça, avec de nombreux supporters, on a envie de pouvoir communier avec eux à la fin et ce n’est pas le cas. Par rapport au peu d’occasions que l’on a subies, c’est très frustrant.

Saint-Étienne fait un écart, Nancy a encore gagné, Montpellier avait perdu, c’était l’occasion de repasser devant... On est à la 13e journée et au-delà du classement, il faut être lucide par rapport à ce ce que l’on est en capacité de faire, même s’il faut rester mesuré, ne pas être alarmiste. Là, la défaite à Grenoble fait encore plus mal.".

A late equaliser for Fortuna Sittard in De Kuip proved costly for Feyenoord as PSV and Twente racked up huge victories to move within two points of the Eredivisie leaders.

Feyenoord paid the price for failing to finish off the Limburgers, with Luciano Valente’s 59th-minute goal the only reward for their dominance.

Fortuna equalised with four minutes left when Shiloh ’t Zand, on loan from Feyenoord, was allowed to run through to the penalty area and beat Tjark Ernst with a low shot.

Industry observers note that feyenoord coach Giovanni van Bronckhorst made no effort to hide his disappointment. “We know that Fortuna are the kind of team who can score from the few attacks they have,” he said. “If you don’t score the goals, things like this can happen.”.

Second-placed Ajax are a point behind after a narrow win at home against AZ ended an 11-match winless streak against the Alkmaar club, as Tolu Arokodare’s early header proved decisive.

Twente recorded the biggest win of the weekend with a 9-0 demolition of Excelsior in Rotterdam, with Wout Weghorst scoring four times and Sondre Ørjasaeter notching up five assists.

According to recent reports, excelsior collapsed following the fifth-minute dismissal of Nesto Groen for a reckless high challenge. The home side were 5-0 down at half-time, with Weghorst claiming a hat-trick in the opening 33 minutes.

PSV bagged seven goals in a one-sided encounter with bottom club Willem II, with all the goals coming from different scorers including Ricardo Pepi, who came on in the second half after a six-week absence through injury.

Telstar opened up a three-point gap at the bottom over ADO Den Haag with a 4-2 win against Utrecht in a painful return to Velsen-Zuid for Telstar’s former coach Anthony Correia.

ADO went down 1-0 in Zwolle, with PEC’s Dylan Mbayo scoring the only goal with a first-time finish on the stroke of half-time.

The match between Cambuur Leeuwarden and Go Ahead Eagles was suspended in the 82nd minute after visiting fans threw fireworks onto the pitch.

The clubs agreed with the KNVB not to play the final minutes and allow Cambuur’s 4-0 advantage to stand as the final result.

Go Ahead’s director Jan-Willem van Dop said the club would take action against those responsible: “I am ashamed on behalf a small group of supporters who ruined things for the club and a large hare of the fans in the away end,” he said.

Cambuur Leeuwarden 4-0 Go Ahead Eagles.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that dans sa dernière édition, L'Union revient sur la déplorable absence des supporters stéphanois dans le parcage du stade Auguste-Delaune. Extraits.

"Selon nos informations, un nouvel encadrement des supporters stéphanois a été créé par les autorités le matin même du match. Des autobus neutres accueillis à un péage sur le parcours et escortés jusqu'au stade. C'est d'ailleurs pour cela qu'ils sont partis. Le parcage d'Auguste-Delaune, de nouveau ouvert, et le Stade de Reims, étaient de nouveau prêts à les faire venir. Et ce, quelques heures avant le coup d'envoi du match. Sauf que la préfecture de la Marne, que nous avons contactée, ne l'a pas entendu de cette oreille et maintient : tout transport véhiculant des Stéphanois entrant dans le département sera intercepté et le parcage visiteur reste fermé.

Industry observers note that mais l'information n'a pas le temps de circuler. Le Stade de Reims l'apprend au dernier moment, pareil pour les supporters stéphanois déjà partis en bus. Certains rebroussent chemin, d'autres persistent. Ce qui donne une scène assez folle au péage de Champfleury, au sud de la Cité des Sacres. Les bus et minibus sont arrêtés par les forces de l'ordre et sommés de retourner d'où ils viennent. Près de 6 heures pour l'aller et la même chose pour le retour. Pour ces supporters, la rencontre se regardera sur la route... Cruel.

According to recent reports, ce qui n'est pas le cas d'autres, plus malins, qui avaient pris leur ticket dans d'autres tribunes, notamment tout proche du parcage resté vide. Munis d'ailleurs sous leur blouson de maillot et d'écharpe aux couleurs de l'ASSE, jusque-là bien cachés, mais qui ont été ressortis au coup d'envoi. Ceux-là, plusieurs centaines, ont pu donner de la voix, surtout après la victoire de leur club. Mais l'ambiance aurait pu prendre plus d'ampleur avec la présence de leurs partenaires. C'est quand même mieux un stade garni...".

La Préfecture de la Marne a manifestement oublié les grands principes de la Répubique : liberté, égalité, fraternité.

Malgré plusieurs situations de but, les Verts ont dû patienter jusqu'à la 40ème minute pour ouvrir la marque : suite à une perte de balle de balle de la défense annecienne, de l'entrée de la surface Noah Fontaine. plaçait une frappe enroulée qui faisait mouche. According to recent reports, la réaction de Kevin De Jesus : "Dans l'ensemble nous avons eu la possession, face à une équipe qui a joué en bloc bas. Il est dommage de ne pas avoir concrétiser les situations que nous nous sommes créées. Mais ce match permet aux jeunes de rester dans le rythme, il permet aussi de donner du temps de jeu à ceux qui en avaient moins et d'intégrer les joueurs revenant de blessure".

La composition : Delgado - R.Fontaine (Boute, 60ème), Diakité (Charreyre, 60ème), Ahamadi, Madjidi (U15) - Evaristo, I.Camara (Moussaoui, 80ème), Moussaoui (Muller, U15, 38ème) - Nebout, Rochette, N.Fontaine.

Dual passports issue continues to plague Dutch-based footballers

📅 03 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (573 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dutchnews

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.
  • See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.
  • Dutch-born footballers who were called up to play for former colonies such as Suriname and Indonesia are still in limbo over their national status, six months after the “passportgate” crisis first flared up.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

Dutch-born footballers who were called up to play for former colonies such as Suriname and Indonesia are still in limbo over their national status, six months after the “passportgate” crisis first flared up.

Suriname’s parliament passed a law in September enabling players who are selected for the national team to gain citizenship automatically.

But the Dutch immigration service IND noted the law passed in Suriname made no difference to the rules on dual nationality in the Netherlands.

“The fact that Surinamese nationality has been obtained by legal means is not enough on its own to qualify for one of the exceptional categories under our law,” a spokesman for the Dutch justice ministry told broadcaster NOS.

The law was intended to settle the question of dual nationality for footballers, which arose last March when NAC Breda challenged the eligibility of Go Ahead Eagles defender Dean James.

James took Indonesian citizenship last year after accepting an invitation to play for the national team, but under Dutch dual nationality rules he was required to give up his original passport.

In a recent development, the Dutch football association KNVB launched an investigation into the employment status of players who were called up by countries such as Suriname, Cape Verde and Indonesia. In the meantime it arranged for Dutch-based players to be given temporary work permits so they could keep playing for their clubs.

Losing Dutch nationality also stripped them of their EU citizenship, meaning they would need to obtain visas and meet stricter criteria, such as an annual salary threshold of €600,000, to be eligible to play in the Eredivisie.

Several players have passed up invitations to join the Surinamese squad because of the uncertainty, including Danilho Doekhi of Lazio, Milan van Ewijk of Coventry City and Jayden Oosterwolde of Fenerbahçe.

National team manager Henk Fraser said it was “inexplicable” that players’ livelihoods were being damaged by their desire to play international football.

“Both countries have to get together and clarify the situation,” he told NOS. “This is a straightforward case of people following their hearts and wanting to play for Suriname, but not knowing where they stand.”.

Some players stated they felt misled by the Surinamese football association, which told them they were playing for the national team on “sports passports” that allowed them to remain Dutch citizens.

Former Feyenoord winger Jean-Paul Boëtius said he only discovered after he was first called up for Suriname last year that he had inadvertently renounced his Dutch citizenship as a result.

Shortly afterwards he received a letter from the city council in Rotterdam telling him to hand in his Dutch passport, which he had recently renewed, because it was no longer valid.

Industry observers note that “I now have a sticker in my Surinamese passport that indicates I have a residency permit allowing me to live in the Netherlands,” he told NOS. “But that’s only for a year. It’s a very difficult situation. I want to become Dutch again. I was born and brought up here.”.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

Feyenoord are facing a heavy fine from European football authorities after fireworks were let off during their Champions League defeat by Internazionale.

In a recent development, referee Glenn Nyberg suspended the match for several minutes after flares were fired onto the roof from outside De Kuip stadium, damaging the structure. Police later made two arrests.

“It’s obviously not right and it’ll be another fine,” coach Giovanni van Bronckhorst stated wearily after the game, which ended in a comprehensive 3-0 defeat for his team.

In a recent development, one flare landed on the pitch despite the club taking measures such as hanging nets from the gantries to stop objects being thrown from the stands. “They’re letting off fireworks from outside now,” Van Bronckhorst mentioned. “What do you do about that?”.

Uefa are likely to hit Feyenoord with a fine and could order the club to close parts of the stadium for their next home matches in the competition, against Porto on November 24 and RB Leipzig on January 27.

The club also have a suspended penalty hanging over them from last October, when they were fined €60,000 after fans let off fireworks during the match against Greek club Panathinaikos.

On the pitch, Feyenoord were undone by a classic display of Italian defending and counter-attacking, as Internazionale sat back after taking an eighth-minute lead through Yann Bisseck.

Francesco Pio Esposito headed in a second early in the second half, just as Feyenoord were pushing for an equaliser, before Piotr Zielinski made sure of the win with a shot from 20 metres.

Captain Luciano Valente said the result was “more than deserved” and the visitors had shown more “quality”.

“This defeat was harder to take than the one against Barcelona,” he told Ziggo Sport. “Because we thought going in that we could get something, but we just weren’t good enough.”.

Van Bronckhorst remarked he was not surprised by the difference in class between the teams. “They scored the first goal out of nothing,” he said. “And Inter know better what the game needs at every stage.

Sources indicate that “Their players have a lot of experience, they’ve been in the final twice in the last four years. So we’re at a disadvantage.”.

As part of PortuGOAL’s efforts to constantly evolve and serve lovers of Portuguese football with top-quality and increasingly accessible content, we are replacing the PortuGOAL Android and Apple APPs with a new Progressive Web Application (PWA) as from tomorrow, Tuesday 3 April.

Industry observers note that this big step forward in phone apps technology loads the content instantly, even in areas of low connectivity, stays up to date at all times, displays the most recent version upon launching, is more efficient than native apps, works on-demand and is always accessible, without taking up a smartphone’s valuable memory or data. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results.

PSV Eindhoven endured a frustrating night in the Champions League as their defensive frailties were exposed in a 2-1 defeat by Club Brugge.

PSV started full of attacking intent and should have taken an early lead when Ivan Perisic put Sergiño Dest clean through on goal, but the defender’s shot was too close to goalkeeper Yann Sommer.

Instead it was the visitors who took the lead with their first real attack when Nicolo Tresoldi headed in a teasing cross from Joaquin Seys.

According to recent reports, PSV equalised early in the second half as an outstanding pass by Sven Mijnans into the path Lutsharel Geertruida allowed the defender to charge to the byline. His pullback found its way to Kodai Sano, whose shot took a deflection off Seys into the net.

But five minutes later PSV were caught out as another razor-sharp pass by Seys released Carlos Forbs in space to net the winner.

The home side refused to give up, but were unable to find a way past Sommer in the closing stages as the Belgian side closed out the win.

Team captain Mauro Junior admitted that PSV had been undone by shortcomings at the back. “We had a lot of opportunities in the first half but we didn’t score,” he told Ziggo Sport.

Industry observers note that “We want to attack and score goals, but we weren’ well organised today in defence. We need to keep our heads up and look forward to the next game.”.

The result leaves PSV in 24th place, just above the elimination line, ahead of their next match away to Real Madrid on November 24, with four points from their opening four matches.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il governatore dice di averne parlato con Tajani e chiede al presidente biancoceleste di misurare il proprio consenso.

Industry observers note that francesco Rocca invita Claudio Lotito a candidarsi con Forza Italia alle comunali di Roma del 2027, per misurare il consenso che saprebbe raccogliere. Secondo quanto riportato da Lacapitale, Il presidente della Regione Lazio rivolge la sfida al senatore e presidente biancoceleste durante «Nexus – Visioni e strategie di sviluppo del territorio», la manifestazione in corso al Palacongressi di Fiuggi, come riferisce La Capitale. Rocca riassume così la sua proposta: «Lotito si candidi a Roma con Forza Italia, così vediamo quanti voti prende, forse qualcuno anche dai romanisti».

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Rocca, tifoso della Lazio e da tempo critico verso la gestione societaria di Lotito, porta così il confronto anche sul piano politico. Le sue parole non sono un annuncio di candidatura da parte di Lotito né una proposta formalizzata dalla coalizione di centrodestra.

In a recent development, il governatore chiama in causa il segretario nazionale di Forza Italia, Antonio Tajani, al quale dice di aver già prospettato una candidatura di Lotito nella Capitale. Collega l’ipotesi alla volontà del presidente della Lazio di proseguire la propria attività politica e al ritorno delle preferenze.

«Ho detto al presidente di Forza Italia Antonio Tajani: visto che Lotito si è innamorato della politica, vuole continuare ed è legittimo, e considerato che tornano le preferenze, dovrebbe candidarlo a Roma», afferma Rocca.

All’invito aggiunge una battuta sulla rivalità tra le due squadre romane: «Così vediamo quante ne prende, forse qualcuna anche dai romanisti». Il punto della sfida, per Rocca, è verificare i voti che Lotito otterrebbe attraverso una candidatura personale.

It has been revealed that il presidente della Regione lega la prova elettorale al ruolo che, a suo giudizio, la Lazio ha avuto nel percorso politico di Lotito. «Questo è il momento della verità per Lotito, per dimostrare che è lui un valore aggiunto per la politica, altrimenti è vero il contrario: è stata la Lazio a portarlo in Senato», sostiene.

Rocca insiste sull’opportunità di cominciare dalle amministrative romane con Forza Italia e richiama anche Reggio Calabria. «Oggi ha la possibilità di dimostrare che la Lazio ha portato tanti consensi a lui e al suo partito. È andato a Reggio Calabria? Si candidasse a Roma, accettasse la sfida, cominciasse già dalle comunali con Forza Italia e vediamo quanto è trascinatore di folle».

Le dichiarazioni si collocano nel confronto politico in vista delle elezioni capitoline del 2027. Restano, però, una sfida lanciata da Rocca a Lotito, non una candidatura annunciata dal presidente biancoceleste.

Né à Firminy, conseiller municipal de Saint-Etienne (depuis 8 mois) et parlementaire le plus investi dans le soutien aux ultras stéphanois (il avait été un des premiers signataires de notre pétition lancée le printemps 2025 et ayant recueilli plus de 5 800 signatures), le député PS ligérien Pierrick Courbon (41 ans) a posté cet après-midi le message suivant sur son compte Instagram.

According to recent reports, "Ce qui s'est passé à Reims est inacceptable ! Les supporters ne sont pas des sous-citoyens, encore moins du bétail. Je saisis le Ministre de l'Intérieur. Malgré trois décisions de justice confirmant l'absence d'interdiction d'accès au stade tout comme les déplacements en autocars, les supporters stéphanois ont été interpellés à proximité du stade Auguste-Delaune, et contraints de faire demi-tour sous escorte policière. Il est indéniable que des erreurs ont été commises par les services de l'Etat, et qu'un contournement des décisions de justice a eu lieu.

Recent findings suggest that les supporters ne sont pas des sous-citoyens. Pourtant, depuis de nombreuses années, le supportérisme est un laboratoire commode de mesures sécuritaires et liberticides, qui ne seraient toélérées dans un autre pan de la société. Comme je m'y suis engagé dès samedi, je viens d'alerter Laurent Nunez pour demander des réponses et des explications. La gestion des supporters en France est catastrophique. Je continuerai de les défendre car l'enjeu dépasse le simple cadre sportif.".

Top five football betting tips and tricks

📅 31 Aug 2018 | ⏱️ 4 min read (784 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Portugoal

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Football is the world’s most famous sport, and it is the sport of choice of a great many sports punters as well.
  • Recent findings suggest that getting started on football betting is far from easy, though.
  • It has been revealed that but experience is not the only thing that can help you become a better football punter.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Football is the world’s most famous sport, and it is the sport of choice of a great many sports punters as well. Especially popular in Europe, betting on football can be an incredibly profitable enterprise, so long as you know how to do it.

Recent findings suggest that getting started on football betting is far from easy, though. This form of gambling requires dedication, investment, and persistence. As you gain experience, your intuition will improve and you will be able to make more correct predictions.

It has been revealed that but experience is not the only thing that can help you become a better football punter. In fact, you can substantially improve your betting strategy by simply following some basic football betting tips.

You might find shopping around boring and unhelpful, but you just have to do it when you search sites for football betting. As you know, the higher the odds, the bigger the payout. What you may have missed, however, is that odds are different at each bookmaker. Having mentioned that, shopping around for the best odds is sensible, as it rewards you with bigger payouts.

It has been revealed that in this line of thought, sticking to one bookmaker is virtually pointless. Even if the bookie of your choosing offers the best odds for a number of matches, it is highly unlikely that their odds will remain the best for long.

An obvious one, we know. And yet, you will be surprised by the number of football bettors who wager on football, but do not follow the sport. So, why is it vital to follow the action closely?

First of all, by watching football matches, you can take part in the most exciting football betting market – the live betting market. What is more vital, however, is that following the action provides an invaluable insight into teams and players’ style, condition, and determination – important factors  to consider when placing a bet.

As you watch more and more games, you will improve your analytic abilities. In time, you will be able to make more accurate predictions about the outcome of different matches, which, of course,  will result in placing more winning bets.

As you know, odds are based on the probability of occurrence of a certain outcome; the higher the odds, the more unlikely it is for that outcome to actually occur. But what happens when the odds offered by the bookmaker represent a probability that is lower than the actual probability of an outcome occurring? In such a situation, you can place what is called a value bet.

If you want to become a professional football punter, you should always search for value when betting, as it leads to huge profits.

Favoured by beginners in particular, accumulators are a type of football wager which allows you to bet on as many fixtures as you like. Most commonly, you will be asked to choose a match winner, but as the market is diverse, you may be offered a number of other betting options. What makes accumulators an appealing betting market is the huge potential payout – here, you can stake as little as £1 and have the potential to win more than £500,000, depending on the bookmaker and the number of selected fixtures.

It has been revealed that if you find accumulators’ payouts too good to be true, you are right. As a matter of fact, there is a reason for the odds to be set so high – actually winning an accumulator bet, especially one which involves a wide selection of matches, is nearly impossible. You see, all you need for your whole wager to lose is one wrong prediction. For example, if you bet on 10 matches and just one of them goes wrong, your entire accumulator is lost.

To make money by betting on football, avoid betting on accumulators – the risk is simply not worth it.

According to recent reports, finally, if you want to be a successful football punter, learn how not to mix emotions with betting. This is easier said than done, though.

According to recent reports, whenever your favourite team plays, you want them to win, regardless of how (im)possible that may be. If you do not learn how to leave emotions out of betting, however, you are highly likely to put money on your favourite team even if they have no chance of winning the match. Conversely, should you base your bets on hard facts and not on emotions, you increase your chances to win.

Our advice – avoid betting on fixtures that involve one of your favourite teams, that is the easiest way to keep emotions at bay.

According to recent reports, les U15 de Benjamin Petit, après leur précieuse victoire d'il y a deux semaines contre Villefranche (1-0) se déplaçaient cet après-midi sur le terrain de l'AS Saint-Priest, qui n'est jamais un adversaire facile. Auparavant, dans la semaine, mercredi, à Cruas, ils s'étaient mesurés à l'Olympique de Marseille, leader de la poule Méditerranée, et qui, en match amical, a largement battu bon nombre d'équipes de renom. Les jeunes Verts avaient mieux fait que se défendre, ne s'inclinant que sur le score de 2 à 1. Revenons-en au match d'aujourd'hui pour dire que la victoire est revenue en toute logique aux jeunes Verts sur le score de 2 à 1, une victoire qui va leur permettre d'engranger des points et....de la confiance.

According to recent reports, ce sont les Sanpriods qui ont ouvert la marque, contre le cours du jeu, à la 19ème minute sur une approximation défensive. Mais les Verts réagissaient immédiatement et, deux minutes plus tard, à la 21ème, Kaïs Boukerma, sur une passe de Charly Davignon, de l'entrée de la surface, plaçait une frappe au ras du poteau pour l'égalisation. Un quart d'heure plus tard, à la 36ème, Hugo Bastide, qui opérait aujourd'hui en défense centrale, récupérait fort à propos un 2ème ballon sur un corner pour donner l'avantage aux Verts. Ce fut difficile après le repos, car Saint-Priest mettait la pression pour revenir au score. Mais les Verts faisaient preuve de solidarité et de rigueur défensive pour conserver cet avantage de 2 à 1.A noter la victoire des U14 sur le score de 8 à 1. Nous reviendrons ultérieurement sur la belle saison de cette équipe.

La composition : Clapeyron - Bergougnoux, Wojcik, Bastide, Uneau - Boukerma, Lebreton (L.La Rosa, 45ème), M.La Rosa (Linganzi Koumba, 40ème) - Fernandes (Moutae, 50ème), Bangoura, Davignon.

La réaction de Benjamin Petit : "Nous avons fait une bonne première mi-temps, même si nous avons un peu manqué de tranchant dans le domaine offensif. Il n'a pas manqué grand chose sur plusieurs situations intéressantes. C'est là un axe de progrès bien identifié que d'aller chercher cette réussite offensive. J'ai apprécié le fait que les garçons soient restés sereins après l'ouverture du score par Saint-Priest. Cela leur a permis de revenir rapidement et de passer devant avant la pause. Par contre, la deuxième mi-temps a été plus compliquée. Saint-Priest nous a mis la pression et nous avons eu plus de mal à construire et à progresser à l'intérieur du jeu. Mais nous avons fait preuve de caractère, de rigueur défensive et cela nous a permis de conserver le résultat.".

Vous avez pu suivre cette rencontre en direct sur notre forum grâce à notre envoyé spécial MachuPicchu42 : les U17 ont concédé un match nul et vierge à la mi-journée face au Cavigal de Nice au Stade Georges Bereta du Centre Robert Herbin.

According to recent reports, dominateurs jusqu'à l'entame du dernier quart d'heure, les Verts ont eu deux grosses occasions en première période. Sur la première, le portier niçois a repoussé le tir à bout portant de Naël Dani. Sur la seconde, un défenseur visiteur a repoussé sur sa ligne une tête d'Isaak Seydi (photo).

En deuxième mi-temps, Lohoré Gobé a eu à son tour une belle opportunité d'ouvrir le score mais sa tentative a été déjouée par le gardien azuréen. Isaak Seydi a de nouveau eu une occase de la tête, hélas non cadrée. Izaya Kimpioka a raté un face à face en tirant à côté. Les visteurs se sont enhardis lors de 20 dernières minutes pas très bien maîtrisées par les Stéphanois mais Andra Laugier n'aura eu aucun arrêt à faire de toute la rencontre.

L'ASSE a perdu sa 5e place au profit de son ex-club partenaire Saint-Priest, qui a cartonné 6-1 le Gazelec Ajaccio (avant-dernier), prochain adversaire des Verts (dimanche prochain en Corse).

La compo : Laugier - Tiambo (Balta, 33') - Mnemoi, Dagbo, Bufferne - Demassieux, Mendy (Thibaudat, 77'), Gobé - Seydi, Kimpioka, Dani (Aytone, 70').

Sources indicate that la réaction de David Le Moal : "On a eu la mainmise sur le match jusqu'au dernier quart d'heure. On a eu pas mal d'occasions, c'est dommage qu'on n'ait pas réussi à les convertir. En première période, on a eu du mal à passer l'adversaire dans le coeur du jeu donc on s'est évertué à contourner le bloc assez bas du Cavigal. On a eu plein de situations de centres mais on a manqué de réalisme dans le dernier geste ou dans l'avant-dernier geste. On a eu plusieurs occasions assez nettes en première période comme en seconde. Je n'ai pas trop compris pourquoi on a reculé lors du dernier quart d'heure, nos adversaires ont eu quelques opportunités en fin de match. Je suis un peu déçu qu'on n'ait pas réussi à marquer mais je suis assez content des vrais gestes défensifs et de la discipline tactique, on a laissé très peu de situations à l'adversaire.".

Lazio e Roma possono allungare a 12 giornate il loro primato congiunto di imbattibilità nel prossimo turno di Serie A. Dopo la sosta per le Nazionali, il campionato 2026-27 riprende con la dodicesima giornata, in programma dal 21 al 23 novembre 2026. Le due squadre capitoline giocheranno entrambe sabato 21 novembre.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Come riportato da Opta, Lazio e Roma sono rimaste entrambe imbattute nelle prime 11 giornate per la prima volta nella storia delle formazioni romane nella massima serie. Il risultato raggiunto prima della pausa può quindi essere migliorato nel prossimo turno: se nessuna delle due perderà, la serie condivisa salirà a 12 giornate.

Industry observers note that le partite delle due squadre sono concentrate nello spazio di poche ore. Alle 15 la Lazio ospiterà il Lecce all’Olimpico; alle 18 toccherà alla Roma, impegnata sul campo del Parma. Saranno questi i due incontri da cui dipenderà la possibilità di prolungare il primato congiunto.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Noham Akil, buteur après son entrée en jeu.

It has been revealed that ayant mis fin le week-end dernier à une série de 5 défaites consécutives, les U19 de Frédéric Dugand, victorieux à domicile du Cap d’Ail (2-1) se déplaçaient à Nice ce dimanche, pour y affronter le très bon club formateur du Cavigal. Une victoire sur la Côte d’Azur permettait aux jeunes Verts de rejoindre son adversaire au classement (13 points).

Sous une légère pluie, dans un stade Bob Rémond, du nom du formateur Niçois, aussi appelé « père spirituel de Robert Herbin », les Stéphanois, réduits à 10 et menés au score ont été cherché l’égalisation en toute fin de rencontre (1-1).

En première période les Verts, avec notamment Noa Moulin, habituellement aligné en réserve, sont bien en place et disciplinés mais restent un peu timides dans leurs actions pour espérer peser davantage sur la rencontre. A la 23ème minute, consécutivement à un corner adverse mal repoussé, le ballon arrive au second poteau, est remis dans la surface verte et repris par un niçois qui vient tromper Mael Massé pour l’ouverture du score. (Cavigal Nice 1 - ASSE 0 ; mi-temps).

Au retour des vestiaires, les Stéphanois plus entreprenants vont chercher l’adversaire plus haut. Progressivement, les contres deviennent verts et la confiance revient. Pourtant à l’heure de jeu, la situation se complique, Tidiane Vibert est exclu pour un geste d’humeur et laisse ses coéquipiers en infériorité numérique. Touchés, mais pas coulés, les Stéphanois, sous l’impulsion notamment de l’entrant Medhy Lutin Zidee à la 56ème continuent à faire bloc et à jouer les coups à fond. Leurs efforts vont être récompensés, à la 84ème minute,  Maxime Lengué Lenou trouve Noham Akil (entré quelques minutes plus tôt) qui du pied droit vient ajuster le portier azuréen. Les Verts sont décomplexés et tiennent ce point précieux qui les voit enchainer une seconde rencontre consécutive sans perdre.

(Cavigal Nice 1 - ASSE 1 ; score final).

Après ce partage des points, les Stéphanois auront la semaine prochaine l’occasion de poursuivre leur série dans leur quête de points pour assurer le maintien avec la réception du  Gazelec Ajaccio, auteur d’un nul aujourd’hui face à Balma (1-1) et comptant le même nombre de points que les Verts, mais un match en moins..

La Composition : Massé  – Lengi (Assoumani 81ème),  E.Mnemoi, N.Mouton, Jolivet, Lengue Lenou– Vibert, Thouilleux (Akil 76ème), Moulin (Gary 56ème), Marliac(Lutin Zidee 56ème) - Zibi.

Sources indicate that la réaction de Frédéric Dugand : « Je suis satisfait du résultat, de la capacité du groupe à avoir respecté le plan de jeu décidé, un peu plus prudent qu’à l’habitude. On fait une bonne seconde période, les joueurs ont eu du répondant. J’ai vu un groupe « habité »des joueurs qui se sont parlé et qui ont été acteurs du match. Le groupe se transforme, il faut capitaliser sur cette attitude, tâcher maintenant d’avoir cette mentalité dès le coup d’envoi, pour aller chercher des émotions ensemble .On peut et on doit aller encore plus loin dans l’investissement et dans la prise de conscience de nos possibilités. ».

#130273. Opinion: The morality of football
